Question: I was charged twice for the same recharge — how do I get a refund?

Answer: Duplicate-charge refunds are usually auto-detected and reversed within 3-5 working days. If not, raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references; approved refunds are credited to the original payment method or as account balance.

Topic: Refunds & Adjustments
